newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: OAU condemns assassination of Burundi prelate.
newsitem.headline: OAU condemns assassination of Burundi prelate.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity (OAU) condemned the killing of Burundi's senior Roman Catholic prelate and renewed its call for peace talks.
"The OAU firmly and strongly condemns this cowardly and awful crime as well as those who perpetrated it," it said.
"The blind violence...for the last three years will not at any rate help Burundians to resolve the prevailing crisis in their country," the OAU added in a statement.
It urged everyone sponsoring violence to stop and said the only solution to bloodshed in Burundi was negotiations among all parties.
Archbishop Joachim Ruhuna was killed in an ambush in the central province of Gitega on Monday with at least one nun.
The Tutsi-dominated army and Hutu rebels blamed each other for the attack.
